task.goal: Compute available machine capacity, quality yield and full-box deliveries in order. Decide whether overtime is required.
constraints: Use only the supplied fictional source pack; do not search or add outside facts.
Return one bare JSON value with no Markdown fences.
Return steps {gross_minutes, net_minutes, started_units, passing_units, explanation}, deliverable_units, shortfall and decision.
Floor completed units after each explicitly stated floor step; never round them to nearest. Show the dependency chain.

rubric.criterion: Derive net minutes from all three machines and downtime.
